beats.label: S1 · Prison Planet call
beats.text: Fu appears at Beerus' planet claiming Trunks is held on his 'Prison Planet' experiment. Goku, Vegeta and Future Mai travel there to free him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Fu as the arc's architect and the mission that pulls the cast off Beerus' world.

beats.label: S1 · Xeno alliance and the barrier
beats.text: They meet Xeno Goku of the Time Patrol and learn a barrier locks them in until they gather Dragon Balls scattered on the planet.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the Time Patrol Saiyans as reluctant allies and the rule that keeps the fights on-planet.

beats.label: S1 · Cumber unleashed
beats.text: Fu releases Cumber, an evil Saiyan whose aura drives Goku berserk. Golden Cooler snaps him out, and Future Mai passes over the Supreme Kai's Potara earrings.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cumber is the season's opposition and the reason the Saiyans reach for fusion; Cooler's presence sets up his later reprisal.

beats.label: S1 · Vegito vs. Golden Great Ape
beats.text: Goku and Vegeta fuse into Vegito to fight Cumber, but he becomes a Golden Great Ape; the strain defuses them without a winner.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows that even fused Blue Kaio-ken cannot close out Cumber, forcing the Xeno pair into the fight.

beats.label: S1 · Xeno Vegito breaks the shield
beats.text: Xeno Goku and Xeno Vegeta arrive as Super Saiyan 4s, fuse into Xeno Vegito, and subdue Cumber with a Kamehameha that breaks the Prison Planet's shield.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The shield's collapse is what lets the villains eventually leave; the fusion is why Cumber survives to be collected.

beats.label: S1 · Ultra Instinct returns
beats.text: Goku reawakens Ultra Instinct and finally beats Cumber. Xeno Goku teleports the others to safety, leaving Goku alone as the planet collapses.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets Goku's Ultra Instinct as the yardstick going forward and isolates him for the cliffhanger.

beats.label: S1 · Zamasu returns
beats.text: Five figures appear. One is Fusion Zamasu, presumed dead. They take the unconscious Cumber and vanish, stranding Goku as the planet explodes.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals the season was a setup for a larger conspiracy and defines every open thread of season 2.

cliffhanger.text: Fu's Prison Planet is destroyed and Goku is stranded on top of it. Fusion Zamasu, supposedly gone, has just arrived with four unknown allies and made off with Cumber.
questions: Who are the four figures standing with Zamasu?
How is Fusion Zamasu alive and one-eyed?
What does his group want with Cumber?

characters.name: Goku
characters.line: Reawakened Ultra Instinct in the final fight; last seen alone on the collapsing Prison Planet.

characters.name: Vegeta
characters.line: Fused with Goku as Vegito during the arc; teleported to safety by Xeno Goku.

characters.name: Future Trunks
characters.line: Freed from Fu's cell after being the bait; back with the group and unhurt.

characters.name: Future Mai
characters.line: Brought word of Trunks' capture and delivered the Supreme Kai's Potara earrings that enabled Vegito.

characters.name: Fu
characters.line: Cosmic experimenter who staged the whole arc; enraged after his lab was destroyed and still at large.

characters.name: Cumber
characters.line: The 'evil Saiyan' whose aura corrupts other Saiyans; unconscious and now in Zamasu's group's custody.

characters.name: Fusion Zamasu
characters.line: Immortal god thought destroyed; returns with an eyepatch, leading a mysterious five-strong faction.

characters.name: Xeno Goku & Xeno Vegeta
characters.line: Time Patrol counterparts from another timeline; fought as Super Saiyan 4s and Xeno Vegito before returning home.

characters.name: Cooler
characters.line: Reappeared as Golden Cooler and chased Fu through his escape portal off the Prison Planet.

beats.label: S2 · Universe 6 invaded
beats.text: Back on Beerus' planet, U6's Supreme Kai begs for help. Tuffle siblings Oren and Kamin, escapees from Fu's planet, are ravaging his universe.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Opens the multi-universe war and introduces the first two members of Hearts' gang.

beats.label: S2 · Hearts and the Universe Seed
beats.text: Their leader Hearts reveals a 'Universe Seed' and a plan to kill the Omni-King and every god. Zamasu, alive and eyepatched, stands with him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the main villain, states the season-long stakes, and confirms who was with Zamasu in the S1 cliffhanger.

beats.label: S2 · Goku returns, Universe 11 falls
beats.text: Goku returns from the Grand Minister with new control of Ultra Instinct as Hearts' gang tears through Universe 11, wounding Jiren and moving on.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Goku back in play, shows Jiren cannot solo the villains, and sets up Universe 11's later assist.

beats.label: S2 · Lagss and Meta Cooler
beats.text: A fifth villain, Lagss, emerges from a Universe Seed crystal. In Universe 3, a robotic Meta Cooler sent by Fu subdues Cumber before overheating and fleeing.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Completes Hearts' roster, removes Cumber from the board, and shows Fu is still steering events from the sidelines.

beats.label: S2 · Kamioren empowered and broken
beats.text: On Earth, Oren and Kamin fuse into Kamioren, whom Hearts empowers with the Universe Seed. Goku masters Ultra Instinct and shatters them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes what the Universe Seed can do and why Hearts will turn it on himself next.

beats.label: S2 · Godslayer Hearts erases Zamasu
beats.text: Hearts absorbs the Seed himself and gains godslayer power. When Zamasu tries to resume his war on mortals, Hearts obliterates him without effort.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the Zamasu thread from S1, defines Hearts' end-form, and sets the ceiling Gogeta must clear.

beats.label: S2 · Gogeta finishes Hearts, Fu waits
beats.text: Goku and Vegeta fuse into Gogeta and, with Jiren and Hit, break Hearts' meteor and kill him. Elsewhere, Fu smiles and readies his next experiment.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the visible arc but explicitly hands the story to Fu, who is the actual continuing thread.

cliffhanger.text: Hearts is dead and his gang is scattered, but the true architect of everything since the Prison Planet, Fu, watches from a hidden lab and declares that his next experiment is about to begin.
questions: Why has he been orchestrating these universe-spanning battles?
Which universe or fighter is his next target?

characters.name: Goku
characters.line: Mastered Ultra Instinct in the fight with Kamioren and fused with Vegeta as Gogeta to finish Hearts.

characters.name: Vegeta
characters.line: Reached his evolved Super Saiyan Blue in Universe 11; fused with Goku via the Fusion Dance into Gogeta.

characters.name: Future Trunks
characters.line: Fought alongside the Saiyans throughout the invasion; back on Earth after Hearts' defeat.

characters.name: Fu
characters.line: Revealed as the true hand behind both arcs; watching from a new lab and announcing his next experiment is ready.

characters.name: Hearts
characters.line: Leader of the Core Area invaders; absorbed the Universe Seed as an 'Ultimate Godslayer' before Gogeta killed him.

characters.name: Jiren
characters.line: Universe 11's strongest, dispatched by his Supreme Kai; helped Gogeta shatter Hearts' meteor.

characters.name: Hit
characters.line: Universe 6's assassin, dispatched by his Supreme Kai; joined Jiren in the final assist on the meteor.

characters.name: Grand Minister
characters.line: Trained Goku in Ultra Instinct between arcs and observed the final battle; sensed Zamasu's death and Hearts' rise.

characters.name: Fusion Zamasu
characters.line: Rejoined Hearts to resume his purge of mortals; erased by Hearts once the Universe Seed was fully absorbed.
